{{Top|leg}}
'''Void Imports''' was a black market shop in [[Point Nadir]]. It was run by [[Ferrika Lazerra]] and was located in a beat-up [[Duraplast/Legends|duraplast]] habitation unit that looked like it was from a first-contact colony.

Due to Ferrika's extensive smuggling and black market contacts, almost anything could be purchased given enough time and [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. She paid kickbacks to the [[Anjiliac]] clan and [[Epsis (organization)|Epsis]] but kept a pair of [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] gunslingers as guards just in case.
